title: C++: Matrix Multiplication
description: Multiply two 3x3 matrices and print the result.

steps.title: Multiply Matrices
steps.description: Use vector<vector<int>> for two 3x3 matrices A and B. Compute C = A * B using nested loops. Print the resulting 3x3 matrix.
hints: C[i][j] = sum over k of A[i][k] * B[k][j]
Three nested loops: for i, for j, for k
